## Purpose

Describe the public documentation, evidence or tooling change.

## Publication checklist

- [ ] Only public material; no credentials, signing data, unpublished launch configuration or private history.
- [ ] Exact Solidity sources/inputs remain unchanged, or a separately reviewed version is identified.
- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Exact compiler reproduction passes where relevant.
- [ ] Full-history and working-tree secret scans pass.
- [ ] Claims distinguish recorded evidence, current chain state, source verification and router admission.

Security-sensitive findings belong in private vulnerability reporting, not this public PR.
